access_ttl_minutes.title: Access token lifetime (minutes)
access_ttl_minutes.description: Other products verify access tokens offline, so revocation reaches them when the token expires: keep it short.

refresh_ttl_days.title: Session lifetime (days)
refresh_ttl_days.description: Absolute lifetime of a session; the customer signs in again afterwards.

sliding_renewal.title: Renew the idle window on every refresh

max_sessions_per_customer.title: Sessions (devices) per customer
max_sessions_per_customer.description: Signing in on one more device ends the least recently used session.

reuse_detection.title: Revoke a session when an old refresh token is replayed

reuse_grace_seconds.title: Concurrent refresh grace (seconds)
reuse_grace_seconds.description: Two tabs refreshing at once within this window get refresh_conflict instead of a revoked session.

audience.title: Token audience (aud)
audience.description: Empty = the website id. Set the same value as the audience of the issuer in the Portal (Website → Identity).

include_email_claim.title: Put the e-mail address in access tokens

include_phone_claim.title: Put the phone number in access tokens

key_prepublish_hours.title: Publish the next key ahead of use (hours)
key_prepublish_hours.description: The Portal refreshes the issuer's JWKS at most hourly: a new key is published this long before it signs.

browser_storage.title: Where the drop-in widget keeps the session
browser_storage.description: local: survives restarts; session: until the tab closes; memory: until reload.
